summary: community.vmware deprecated connect_to_api, host_version_at_least, inventory plugin utils, httpapi, vcenter_folder and several vmware helper functions, plus vmware_cluster_ha, for removal in 7.0.0.
questions: Is connect_to_api deprecated in community.vmware module_utils?

answer_card.title: community.vmware deprecations (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated, mostly removed in **community.vmware 7.0.0**:

- module_utils: `connect_to_api`, `host_version_at_least`, `find_host_portgroup_by_name`, `find_vmdk_file`, `network_exists_by_name`, `vmdk_disk_path_split`; `vm_device_helper` `is_nvdimm_controller`, `is_nvdimm_device`.
- `plugin_utils.inventory` and `plugins.httpapi`.
- Modules: `vcenter_folder`, `vmware_cluster_ha`.
